MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The #8 wood screws felt like a natural next choice because I recently chose #8 wood construction screws; their shorter length could suit a shallower fastening job.",
    "That recommendation recognized my repeated interest in fastening wood, which connects my framing nails and wood screws more closely than general repair supplies do."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts may look related to screws, but they serve bolt connections rather than the wood fastening work suggested by my recent choices.",
    "Hose fittings, hose clamps and the relief valve require a specific repair and matching dimensions that I have no current reason to need.",
    "Epoxy and wire brushes could help with other maintenance tasks, but I have no immediate bonding or surface-cleaning job; eighteen rolls of tape also exceed my current needs.",
    "The brewing tester did not fit my interests; choosing measuring cups does not mean I am making beer or wine."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seemed to treat tools, hardware and repair supplies as interchangeable interests, although I am mainly looking for useful fasteners right now.",
    "A single measuring-cup purchase seemed to suggest a specialized measuring hobby without evidence that I need brewing equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of framing nails and wood screws suggest that the material being fastened and the fastening method matter more than a broad connection to maintenance.",
    "Screw gauge and length help me judge whether something could suit my work; specialized replacement parts need a matching task before I would consider them.",
    "Quantity matters to my immediate usefulness: buying fasteners in packs does not mean I need a large supply of every maintenance item."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my wood-fastening needs but stretched that interest too broadly into unrelated repairs and specialized equipment."
}
